outlook_text: Over the next few days, dry conditions are forecast over parts of the southern ASEAN region, except over parts of Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra, Borneo and Java where showers are expected. While showers may bring some respite, the hotspot and smoke haze situation is likely to remain elevated especially over areas experiencing prolonged dry conditions, with a continued risk of transboundary haze occurrence. The prevailing winds over the southern ASEAN region are forecast to blow generally from the southeast to southwest, except over northern and eastern parts of Borneo where the winds are expected to blow from the north to northeast. Showers are forecast over the northern ASEAN region, except for relatively drier conditions over the northwestern and southeastern parts of the Mekong sub-region. Hotspot activity is likely to stay low. The prevailing winds over the northern ASEAN region are expected to blow from the northeast to east, apart from the northern parts of Mekong sub-region where the winds are forecast to be light and variable in direction.
